lines.text: Wait! What Happens If You Step on Jupiter? (No Floor!)!
Most kids guess totally wrong about can you stand on jupiter!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Jupiter is a giant gas planet of hydrogen.
and helium with no rocky ground to stand on.
gravity and pressure crush deeper layers inward.
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind No Floor On Jupiter!
